description: The configuration of i2a. An account connects; each conversation is in one space; a space sends its conversations to one agent on one schedule. Check a file with `i2a config check`.

accounts.description: The logins to chat tools. An account only connects. Add one with i2a account add, which keeps the token in the secret store.

id.description: The stable ID: 1-32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _. The token in the secret store uses it.

name.description: The name that i2a shows. Empty: the ID.

platform.description: The chat tool of the account.

read_every.description: The time between two reads of the account. At least 5s. Default: 1m, or 10s for WhatsApp.

url.description: The server URL of a Mattermost account, with https:// or http://.

user.description: The Mattermost username. i2a writes it after the connection check.

agents.description: How i2a sends a batch to an AI agent. A space names one agent.

batch.description: A Go template of the prompt of each batch. Empty: the built-in prompt.

cli.description: The agent CLI that Orca starts, for example claude.

driver.description: orca types the batch into an agent terminal of Orca. dry-run only writes the digest file.

id.description: The stable ID: 1-32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _. Spaces name it.

inline_max_bytes.description: The largest inline prompt in bytes, from 1024 to 65536.

message_max_chars.description: The longest message text in a batch, from 100 to 20000 characters.

model.description: The model of the agent CLI. Empty: the default of the CLI.

name.description: The name that i2a shows. Empty: the ID.

orca_bin.description: The path of the orca command. Empty: orca in PATH.

payload.description: pointer: the prompt names the digest file. inline: the prompt contains the messages.

primer.description: A Go template of the first prompt of a session. Empty: the built-in primer.

session.description: new: a new terminal for each batch. reuse: one terminal for each space while it is live. worktree: a new Git worktree for each batch.

workspace.description: The folder of the agent terminal. The orca driver needs it.

enabled.description: Show macOS notifications for new cards and failed dispatches.

min_urgency.description: The lowest card urgency that gives a notification: high, normal or low.

schedules.description: When a space sends. A space names one schedule.

days.description: The days of the sends. Empty: each day.

every.description: The time between two sends, from the start of the hours. At least 1m.

hours.description: The hours of the sends in local time, HH:MM-HH:MM. Empty: all day.

id.description: The stable ID: 1-32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _. Spaces name it.

name.description: The name that i2a shows. Empty: the ID.

settings.description: The message limits of the store.

lookback.description: First-run window and maximum age of a waiting message. At least 1m.

retention.description: Keep sent messages and digests for this time.

spaces.description: The groups of conversations that you name. Each space sends its conversations to one agent on one schedule.

agent.description: The ID of the agent of the space.

conversations.description: The conversations of the space. A conversation can be in many spaces, each with its own read level; it is not two times in one space.

account.description: The ID of the account of the conversation.

id.description: The platform ID of the conversation. i2a conversations --json lists them.

label.description: The name that you give. It replaces the platform name on the screens.

name.description: The platform name. The dashboard writes it.

read.description: all: each message. mentions: the messages for you (a mention, a reply to you, each message of a direct conversation). off: no message. Default: all in a space; the read of unsorted in Unsorted. The source reads at the widest level of the links of a conversation; each space gets the messages of its own level.

id.description: The stable ID: 1-32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _. It cannot be unsorted.

name.description: The name that i2a shows. Empty: the ID. Two spaces cannot have the same name.

schedule.description: The ID of the schedule of the space.

unsorted.description: The built-in space of each conversation that no space lists.

agent.description: Empty: hold the messages until you sort their conversations.

conversations.description: The conversations in Unsorted that have their own read level or label.

account.description: The ID of the account of the conversation.

id.description: The platform ID of the conversation. i2a conversations --json lists them.

label.description: The name that you give. It replaces the platform name on the screens.

name.description: The platform name. The dashboard writes it.

read.description: all: each message. mentions: the messages for you (a mention, a reply to you, each message of a direct conversation). off: no message. Default: all in a space; the read of unsorted in Unsorted. The source reads at the widest level of the links of a conversation; each space gets the messages of its own level.
The read level of a conversation that no space lists: all, mentions or off.

schedule.description: The ID of the schedule of Unsorted. Default: the first schedule.

version.description: The version of the file format. i2a writes 2.

title: i2a configuration (config.toml)
